rows.remains: Round-60 review (cross-session message, verified against code): (1) CONFIRMED ordering defect: platform.rs stage_reason calls organisation.dispatch (~:18290) before reason_symbolically (~:18424), so in a production cycle the Symbolic Reasoning Brain reports no data on the first hypothesis and the previous hypothesis's derivation afterwards. It cannot simply be reordered: the derivation takes report.is_contested() from the panel's dispatch. Closing it needs a third dispatch phase run after the kernel's derivation (a split of Organisation::dispatch plus a platform.rs reorder) and a test that reads the cycle's own panel report; not built, a design decision. (6) CONFIRMED: OrganisationReport::covered_scopes has no production caller, and qip-deepbrain brains::standard derives coverage from roster manifests, so removing SymbolicReasoningAnalyst from standard_agents does not drop the scope on a deployed node (a manifest without an agent is allowed). The clause 'removing it drops its scope from coverage' is met only by the organisation test, not on a deployed node. NEEDS_PERSON: decide whether coverage should come from constructed agents or reported findings. Fixed in this follow-up: (2) desk_view test now asserts independently computed expected values; (3) temporal reasoner derived only when a link held, zero-link and all-refused tested; (4) blocking constraint ids emitted as finding.evidence 'blocking_constraint:<id>', asserted exactly; (5) reasoners_derived asserted against a count taken from the derivation. The first commit's 'CLAIMS_COMPLETE' is withdrawn. Remaining from the first pass: nothing in DECIDE reads the finding; check-dependencies.sh not run (no dependency added).
